sentences.text: ORAL ORDER

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.181/2023 registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506 read with Section 34 of the IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Heard Sri. Lethif B., learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri. B.N. Jagadeesha, learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Smt. Renuka Devi A.S., learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3. During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute among themselves and have filed a compounding application along with the affidavits.

The affidavits read as follows:
NC: 2026:KHC:5433 HC-KAR "AFFIDAVIT I, Chinnaswamaiah B, S/o, late Basavaraju, Aged about 77 years, R/at: MIG-19, Shivakrupa Nilaya, Nrupatunga Road, Kuvempunagar, 1st Phase, Mysuru City, Mysore District 570023,

Today at Bengaluru, do herby solemnly affirm and state as follows:
I, Chandrika, W/o. Chinnaswamaiah. B, Aged about 63 years, R/at : MIG-19,
Shivakrupa Nilaya, Nrupatunga Road, Kuvermpunagar, 1st Phase, Mysuru City,
Mysore District - 570 023, Today at Bengaluru, do herby solemnly affirm and state as follows:
1.
We are the petitioners/Accused No.2 and 3 in the charge sheet, we know the facts and circumstances of the case and we are deposing hereunder.
2. We state that we have challenged the filing of Charge sheet and taking cognizance by the learned Magistrate in the above Petition.
3. We state that, the dispute between the accused No.1 and respondent No.2 has been resolved with the intervention of our family members, relatives and friends.

4. We state that, the dispute has been amicably settled out of court with a condition that, the both husband and wife has decided to dissolve their marriage before the family court by filing mutual divorce petition.

5. We state that, the respondent No.2 has received sum of Rs.18,00,000/- as a permanent alimony from the accused No.1 as a full and final settlement and there is no other litigation pending between us.
